trust_decision.summary: Files read back from data/cache and data/meta (draft, page metadata, instruction cache, extension-repo cache) are trusted to contain only plain serialized arrays; unserialize() is called with no allowed_classes restriction, so any file content that becomes attacker-influenced can instantiate arbitrary classes.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names 'Draft'; Draft::getDraftText is the only unserialize in the draft code and reads the file written by saveDraft (inc/Draft.php:94).

fix_sites.entry_point: do=draft page view -> inc/Ui/PageDraft.php:29 Draft::getDraftText (draft written via AJAX draftsave, inc/Ajax.php:163-164)
any page view / metadata read via p_get_metadata -> p_read_metadata (inc/parserutils.php:282, 371, 446; inc/File/PageFile.php:258)
admin extension manager -> Repository::getExtensionData / bulk lookup (lib/plugins/extension/Repository.php:138, 186)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/plugins/extension/Repository.php:307 (bundled plugin cache of remote repository data) and inc/Cache/CacheInstructions.php:30 (parser instruction cache); both are save/reload paths unrelated to drafts

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about drafts; instruction cache and page metadata are written only by DokuWiki itself (inc/Cache/CacheInstructions.php:45, inc/parserutils.php:505) and the extension cache lives in a bundled admin-only plugin, so a solver can argue these files are trusted internal state.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Instruction cache must still round-trip stdClass values inside instructions; the published fix allows ['stdClass'] there instead of false, so an over-broad allowed_classes=>false would break cached rendering of instructions carrying stdClass.

O6_input_shapes: serialized draft array (prefix/text/suffix) from cache dir
serialized page metadata array (current/persistent) from meta dir
serialized parser instruction list (may include stdClass) from cache dir
serialized extension data array from .repo cache file

O7_producer.where: inc/Draft.php:94, inc/parserutils.php:505, inc/Cache/CacheInstructions.php:45, lib/plugins/extension/Repository.php:294 (serialize() into files)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a generic retrieveCache helper that unserializes cache payloads for subclasses
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Repository.php:294/307 already wraps the generic Cache with serialize/unserialize by hand; a maintainer could fold that into the base class.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: persisting the per-request auth_isadmin result cache to disk with serialize/unserialize
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Cache key is already built with serialize(); moving it to a file cache is a plausible performance change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a media metadata or subscription cache stored via getCacheName and read with unserialize
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getCacheName is the shared cache-file primitive used by drafts (inc/Draft.php:29); other features storing arrays there would naturally use serialize.

O9_family: insecure deserialization (PHP object injection via unserialize of file-backed state)

O10_build.project_tests: _test/ (core phpunit suite incl. parserutils/cache tests) and lib/plugins/extension/_test/ (ExtensionTest, ManagerTest, etc.); fix adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add ['allowed_classes' => false] only to Draft::getDraftText (or harden draft file locking) and leave the metadata, instruction-cache and extension-cache unserialize calls unchanged.

out_of_scope_notes: vendor/simplepie/simplepie/src/Cache/File.php:88 unserializes cache files, but DokuWiki disables SimplePie caching (inc/Feed/FeedParser.php:19), so it is not a live route.
The 'race condition' mechanism that makes the draft file attacker-influenced was not identified in the pinned code; only the unserialize sinks were screened.
